high_level_description: The image shows the side view of an American Airlines aircraft parked on the tarmac at an airport. The plane is predominantly white with the "American" logo prominently displayed in blue letters along the fuselage. The tail features the iconic red, white, and blue stripes of the American flag. The landing gear is extended, indicating that the plane is either preparing for takeoff or has recently landed. In the background, there are other airplanes and parts of the airport infrastructure, including what appears to be a control tower and some buildings.
